data.title: Velora 2
data.about:
After the success of Velora 1, Emaar Properties has launched Velora 2. The project at The Valley Phase 2 by Emaar Properties offers 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses in a serene, nature-inspired setting. These homes combine modern design and spacious layouts, featuring large windows that create a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Velora 2 by Emaar offers a unique real estate investment opportunity with flexible payment plans. In The Valley, Velora 2 by Emaar Properties provides quick access to key areas like Expo 2020, Dubai South, and Jebel Ali.

Residents enjoy The Valley Velora Phase 2 amenities, including pools, a fitness center, and nature-themed play areas. This thoughtfully designed master plan blends urban convenience with natural beauty, making Velora 2 in The Valley a perfect choice for families seeking comfort and style. With its strategic location, premium amenities, and elegant design, Velora Phase 2 townhouses offer tranquility and modern living.

characteristics_module.description:

  • Spacious layouts: Velora 2 townhouses feature practical layouts, refined finishes, and expansive indoor-outdoor living.  
  • Family-friendly amenities: The Valley Velora 2 amenities include pools, sports zones, skate parks, and outdoor play areas.  
  • Active lifestyle: The development offers cycling tracks, jogging paths, picnic spots, and outdoor BBQ areas.  
  • Flexible investment: Velora Emaar real estate investment offers an 80/20 payment plan with a handover in July 2028.  
  • Nature-connected living: Homes designed for a serene, balanced lifestyle surrounded by lush greenery and meadows.
